verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents two official MCP servers. One exposes its search and reasoning capabilities to AI assistants [docs-36]. The other is the Computer MCP server, which lets any MCP client delegate multi-step tasks such as browsing and sandboxed code execution and receive structured results [docs-5, docs-38, docs-17]. A probe confirms the official MCP server documentation is live [probe-4]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent via these servers, and setup details (transport, auth, client config) in the evidence.
